content:
- Read improve-code-boundaries skill and repo status.
- Existing uncommitted changes are present in Ralph files and tests/ha/support/invariants/primary_count.rs, so I will avoid reverting unrelated work.
- Next: inspect likely boundary-smell candidates in src/tests and pick one narrow cleanup that reduces code.

- Chose a concrete boundary cleanup in src/process: ProcessWorkerBootstrap duplicates ProcessWorkerCtx, and ProcessWorkerCtx::new is pure pass-through glue.
- Verified current baseline with make check before editing.
- Next: remove ProcessWorkerBootstrap/new, patch direct ProcessWorkerCtx construction at each call site, then rerun checks.

- Removed ProcessWorkerBootstrap and ProcessWorkerCtx::new; callers now build ProcessWorkerCtx directly.
- make check passed after the boundary collapse, and there are no remaining references to the removed layer.
- Next: run make lint, make test, and make test-long in order; fix any failures before committing.

- make test failed once on api::worker::tests::reload_certificates_succeeds_for_https_transport_and_signals_postgres with a signal log timeout.
- Re-ran that test in isolation: it passed immediately, so this presents as an existing flake rather than a deterministic regression from the ProcessWorkerCtx cleanup.
- Confirmed the bug is already tracked in .ralph/tasks/bugs/reload-certificates-signal-log-timeout.md; next: rerun make test, then continue to make test-long if green.

- Investigated the flaky API reload-certificates test and found its fake postgres helper lacked any readiness barrier before signals could be sent.
- Patched src/api/worker.rs so the helper writes a ready file after installing the HUP trap and the test waits for that file before proceeding.
- Stress reruns hit an existing tracked nextest incremental archive bug, so next: rerun the required make targets sequentially to validate the fix in the repo-supported path.

- Validation is green: make lint passed, make test passed after fixing the API test readiness race, and make test-long passed all 16 ultra-long HA scenarios.
- Final code changes are confined to the process worker boundary cleanup plus the API fake-postgres readiness helper.
- Next: commit only the files I changed, then run .ralph/task_switch.sh.
